articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Native Multimodal Reasoning and Extended Context
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning across text, image, audio, and video inputs with a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates significant gains in complex multi-step reasoning benchmarks and exhibits markedly reduced hallucination rates compared to GPT-4o. Enterprise API pricing reflects a tiered structure based on context utilization, signaling a shift in how foundation model providers monetize long-context workloads.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Scientific Reasoning Tasks
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2, which sets new records on GPQA-Diamond, MathVista, and a newly introduced scientific literature synthesis benchmark. The model integrates a chain-of-thought verification layer that self-audits reasoning steps before producing final answers. Researchers highlight its potential to accelerate drug discovery pipelines and materials science simulations when paired with domain-specific retrieval systems.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Pilot Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in limited production roles at its Austin Gigafactory, handling component sorting, bin picking, and inter-station material transport. The Gen 3 units feature upgraded dexterous hands with 22 degrees of freedom and on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation. Tesla reports a 40% improvement in manipulation reliability over Gen 2, though full autonomous operation still requires human supervisory oversight.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Production
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Bezos Expeditions, bringing its valuation to approximately $12 billion. The funding will support construction of a dedicated manufacturing facility in South Carolina with an initial annual capacity target of 10,000 humanoid units. Figure's robots are currently being piloted in BMW logistics operations and Amazon warehouse environments with promising early throughput metrics.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Persistent Memory and Sandboxed Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major update to the Claude platform enabling autonomous multi-step tool-use agents with persistent memory across sessions and sandboxed code execution environments. The system supports orchestrated workflows where Claude can browse the web, execute Python and shell commands, manage files, and interact with external APIs while maintaining strict safety guardrails. Early enterprise adopters report significant productivity gains in software engineering, data analysis, and IT operations automation.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node for Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production ramp of its A14 (1.4nm-class) process technology, with initial wafers allocated to NVIDIA's next-generation Blackwell Ultra AI accelerators and Apple's M6 lineup. The node delivers an estimated 20% performance uplift and 25% power efficiency gain over N2, using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery. This production milestone is critical for sustaining the compute scaling demanded by frontier AI model training.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink clearance to proceed with human trials of its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and features a fully wireless bidirectional data link with on-chip signal processing. The second-generation device targets both motor restoration for paralysis patients and a new investigational protocol for treatment-resistant depression. The approval follows 18 months of data from the first cohort of N1 implant recipients showing stable long-term signal quality.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Integrated LLM-Based Task Planning
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, in collaboration with parent company Hyundai, officially launched the commercial Atlas platform featuring an integrated large language model planner that translates natural-language task descriptions into executable whole-body motion sequences. The electric humanoid can autonomously navigate unstructured environments, manipulate irregular objects, and recover from falls using reinforcement-learning-trained reflexes. Initial deployments target Hyundai shipyard operations and construction site logistics.
